title: Consulting Services for Comprehensive Plan Update - Shrewsbury
short_description: Consulting services for updating the City of Shrewsbury comprehensive plan.
project_scope: Preparation of a new comprehensive plan for the City of Shrewsbury. The scope covers citywide strategic planning and multidisciplinary consulting related to land use planning, master planning, and urban studies/planning/design. No building, bridge, structural, span, or gross floor area information is provided.
services: Multidisciplinary consulting services for comprehensive plan update, including land use planning, master planning, and urban planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure comprehensive planning and urban/master planning service.
- No structural engineering, bridge, building, roof, facade, or special structure component identified.
- Falls under urban/open space planning, which is explicitly not a target area.
- No planning component for civil engineering structures or structural design is described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget or cost information is stated in the source. The notice concerns planning for a comprehensive plan update rather than a defined construction project, so no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee, honorarium, or budget for consulting services is stated in the source.
references_qualifications: Qualified multidisciplinary consulting firms with capabilities in land use planning, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
contracting_authority: City of Shrewsbury, Missouri, St. Louis, MO, USA. Contact: Dustin Ziebold. Phone: 314-647-5795. Fax: 314-647-1811. Email: dziebold@shrewsburymo.gov. Website: https://www.shrewsburymo.gov/how_do_i/apply_for/bid_opportunities.php
notes: Questions deadline: 2026-06-12 05:00 PM CDT. Solicitation documents available online. Although categorized under General Building in the source system, the actual procurement is for a city comprehensive plan update, not a building project.
